name: workflow-radar
description: Score business workflows for friction and AI suitability, estimate ROI with Monte Carlo uncertainty, and produce a prioritized AI roadmap.
author: Sean McRae

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js report examples/*.yaml --out report
scripts.sample: npm run build && node dist/cli.js report examples/*.yaml --out docs/sample-report && cp docs/sample-report/quadrant.svg docs/img/quadrant.svg
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
